# OTITIS EXTERNA

## Acute Localized Disease

Often due to furunculosis and usually associated with Staphylococcus aureus.
Treat mild cases with moist local heat. For cases with cellulitis or deep invasion, incision and drainage as well as systemic antibiotics may be needed.
Refer to the [Furuncles and Carbuncles](furuncles-and-carbuncles) page for antibiotic recommendations.
Furuncles and Carbuncles

---

## Acute diffuse and chronic otitis externa

Most commonly associated with Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Staphylococcus aureus and Staphylococcus epidermidis. Irrigate to remove cerumen, desquamated skin and purulent material which can improve effectiveness of topical antibiotics. Avoid products that contain neomycin if the tympanic membrane is perforated. Treat for 7 to 10 days

Therapy:
## Inpatient/Outpatient

### Preferred treatment if tympanic membrane is intact

Neomycin-polymyxin-hydrocortisone ear drops 4 drops in affected ear(s) QID for 7 days ($) [M]

### Alternative if tympanic membrane is perforated or allergy to preferred treatment

Ciprofloxacin-Dexamethasone otic 4 drops in affected ear(s) BID for 7 days ($)
[M]

### Complicated Cases

For cases resistant to topical therapy alone, patients with poorly controlled diabetes mellitus, immunocompromised patients, cases where infection has spread beyond ear canal and in those where topical therapy cannot be delivered effectively. Culture secretions to guide therapy.
In addition to topical therapy above
< ADD > ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO q12h for 7 days ($) [R,DI]

## ER/UC

### Acute Localized Disease

Refer to the [Furuncules and Carbuncles](furuncles-and-carbuncles) page for antibiotic recommendations.

### Acute diffuse and chronic otitis externa

Most commonly associated with Pseudomonas aerogenosa and Staphylococcus aureus/epidermidis. Irrigate to remove cerumen, desquamated skin and purulent material which can improve effectiveness of topical antibiotics. Avoid products that contain neomycin if the tympanic membrane is perforated.
Treat for 7 to 10 days

### Preferred treatment if tympanic membrane is intact

Neomycin-polymixin-hydrocortisone ear drops 4 drops in affected ear(s) QID

### Alternative if tympanic membrane is perforated or allergy to preferred treatment

Ciprofloxacin-Dexamethasone otic 4 drops in affected ear(s) BID ($) [M]

### Complicated Cases

For cases resistant to topical therapy alone, diabetic patients, immunocompromised patients, cases where infection has spread beyond ear canal and in those where topical therapy cannot be delivered effectively. Culture secretions to guide therapy.

### Empirical Treatment

In addition to topical therapy above <ADD>
Ciprofloxacin 500 mg PO BID ($) [R,DI]
